status: partial display harness study with removable grip hardware and a rear cable guard
coordinate_frame: installed X, Y and height above the base bottom, in mm
module_connector_basis: Nominal solid in the saved native PCB export, matched to the 26.25 x 3.95 x 1.05 mm connector shell in the official Mu Ultra STEP. The module drawing identifies the connector at this edge; cable exit is +X.
radius_basis: Space-study requirement only. The I-PEX 20453 revision 38 drawing says to confirm bend radius with the harness maker; it does not establish this assembly's static or repeated-flex limit.
fanout_basis: Available tapering space, not an approved wire lay or connector assembly. The complete terminated plug, fanout and first bend must be drawn by the harness maker.
opening_basis: User-selected 135 degree opening, matching the saved stop prototype. Loads and the assembled opening tolerance still need qualification.
anchor_basis: Split metal jaw prototypes with flush screws, reinforcement mounts and removable lining. Cable compression, pull retention and mounting loads still need qualification.
case_changes_scope: The reliefs are applied only to the separate display-hinge study, not to the saved full case.
grip_liner_status: 3.7 mm outside / 3.1 mm inside split lining prototype around the 3 mm cable budget. It has 0.1 mm diametral clearance and is not a qualified friction clamp.
